name: @verispec/adapter
description: VeriSpec trace recorder for TypeScript and JavaScript: record what your implementation did, so that `verispec check-trace` can decide whether it follows the contract.

scripts.build: npm run build:esm && npm run build:cjs && node scripts/finalize-cjs.mjs
scripts.gen: verispec gen-tests ../../examples/bank.yaml --lang typescript -o test/bank.verispec.test.ts && verispec gen-tests ../../examples/bank.yaml --lang javascript -o test/js/bank.verispec.test.js
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/esm/test/*.js test/js/*.js
